__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: The Prometheus that fetches the Node Exporter (job node)

description: The Unraid Secretary Office's own numbers (Mr. Backupsy, Ms. Snapshotini, the team lead, the night watchman …) and a few of the server's, through the Node Exporter's textfile collector.

panels.title: USO numbers written
panels.description: How long ago the Unraid Secretary Office's agent last wrote its numbers (once a minute). Red: the agent stopped writing — is it running, is the array started? The Node Exporter keeps serving the last files, so the other panels show old values then.

panels.title: USO version
panels.description: The version of the Unraid Secretary Office's agent that writes the numbers.

panels.title: USO agent running since
panels.description: When the Unraid Secretary Office's agent started (it restarts itself after an update).

panels.title: USO textfile collector
panels.description: Whether the Node Exporter could read the Unraid Secretary Office's folder of numbers (node_textfile_scrape_error). Error: the folder is missing (the agent creates it) or a file is broken.

panels.title: USO left out (size cap)
panels.description: Metric families the Unraid Secretary Office left out to stay under its size cap (16 KB — the folder lives in a 1 MB RAM disk shared with the backup's mount points). The agent log names them.

panels.title: Last backup
panels.description: How the last real backup run ended: ok or with warnings counts as went well.

panels.title: Since the last good backup
panels.description: Time since the last real backup run that went well ended. Orange after 26 hours (a night missed), red after 50 hours.

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: Whether the engine is running right now (a backup, a check or a dry run), and its phase.

panels.title: Kopia sources (last run)
panels.description: Kopia sources of the last real backup run: copied, and not copied (failed or never reached).

panels.title: Problems (last run)
panels.description: Errors and warnings of the last real backup run.

panels.title: Last skipped run
panels.description: A run that couldn't start because the engine was still busy (e.g. Kopia still uploading the night before) — how long ago, and why. Engine 2.20 or newer.

panels.title: Last run took
panels.description: Duration of the last real backup run, and how long containers and VMs were held (downtime).

panels.title: Packages written
panels.description: What the last real backup run wrote into the packages of apps and VMs (templates, compose files, dumps, VM configuration).

panels.title: Downtime and duration per night
panels.description: Each real backup run's downtime (containers and VMs held) and its whole duration — a step per run.

panels.title: Package sizes
panels.description: The size of each package (app, VM, flash) in the backup place after the last real backup run. Left out when the Unraid Secretary Office's numbers would grow over their size cap.

panels.title: Kopia sources per night
panels.description: Kopia sources of each real backup run: copied and not.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: When the engine ran (backups, checks, dry runs).

panels.title: Snapshots per pool
panels.description: Snapshots per ZFS pool, btrfs disk and of the VMs, without Docker's image layers — as of Ms. Snapshotini's last look (a btrfs disk she hasn't read since the agent started is left out).

panels.title: Newest snapshot
panels.description: How old the newest snapshot of each pool or disk is. Orange after 26 hours, red after 8 days.

panels.title: Snapshot plans with problems
panels.description: Ms. Snapshotini's active plans whose last run failed or only partly worked.

panels.title: She last looked
panels.description: When Ms. Snapshotini last read the snapshots (her scans, and every plan run). The numbers here are from then.

panels.title: Space held by snapshots
panels.description: What the snapshots of each ZFS pool hold (ZFS usedbysnapshots).

panels.title: Snapshots over time
panels.description: Snapshots per pool and disk over time — retention at work.

panels.title: Still to do
panels.description: Musts: something a desk can't work without. Only you can do it, in Unraid.

panels.title: Recommended
panels.description: Recommendations not in place and not put aside with «I know, thanks».

panels.title: Good to know
panels.description: Notes worth knowing (other backup tools …), not put aside.

panels.title: Open points over time
panels.description: The team lead's open points by level — as of his tours (every 30 minutes, and whenever his page is open).

panels.title: He last looked
panels.description: When the team lead last walked through the house.

panels.title: Open findings by kind
panels.description: What the night watchman noticed that differs from normal and isn't noted yet, by kind.

panels.title: Last round
panels.description: How long ago the night watchman made his last round. Orange after 3 hours, red after 26 hours.

panels.title: Open findings over time
panels.description: The night watchman's open findings by kind.

panels.title: Sent to clients per service
panels.description: What the server sent to clients over SMB, NFS, SSH and the WebGUI, per second (the night watchman's data flow: the kernel's counters of the open connections, read every round — five minutes —, so the curve moves in five-minute steps). The Unraid Secretary Office's own Kopia upload is not in here: it goes out from the Kopia container.

panels.title: Written into shares per hour (top 8)
panels.description: What was written into each ZFS share per hour (ZFS written: rewritten files count too — the pattern of encrypting ransomware), stacked, the eight shares with the most in that hour. The Unraid Secretary Office's own backups and restores are in here too; the night watchman keeps them apart in his book.

panels.title: Ms. Protocolli, Jack Emby, Ms. Dustdevil
Log lines at her last tour
panels.description: Lines that looked like an error or a warning in Ms. Protocolli's last tour (since the tour before; the first one looks back 24 hours). She counts, she doesn't judge.

panels.title: Container logs
panels.description: All containers' docker logs together, at her last tour.

panels.title: EmbyCache on the pool
panels.description: What EmbyCache keeps on the fast pool right now (as of Jack Emby's last look).

panels.title: Jack's last real runs
panels.description: Whether the last real run of EmbyCache and of the gather went well.

panels.title: Storeroom
panels.description: What lies in Ms. Dustdevil's storeroom, put away and not yet emptied.

panels.title: CPU busy
panels.description: The share of CPU time not idle, all cores together.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Memory in use (without what Linux would give back from its caches).

panels.title: /var/log
panels.description: Unraid's RAM disk for logs (128 MB). Full, Unraid stops logging. Orange at 60 %, red at 80 % — the team lead's levels.

panels.title: /mnt/addons
panels.description: Unraid's RAM disk for add-on mounts (1 MB): the backup's mount points and the Unraid Secretary Office's numbers share it.

panels.title: RAM disks over time
panels.description: How full /var/log and /mnt/addons are.

panels.title: Up since
panels.description: When the server last started.
